scope: Finite descriptive audit of the exact sufficient local-objective condition on the already-fitted target population and fixed label-change groups; no search, fitting, model/parameter changes, CIs, model selection or gate reopening.
motivation_from_completed_evidence: Target diagnosis: fit concentration gain transfers weakly to WebVid pilot and essentially not to Yandex pilot; WebVid main Recall harm is predominantly seen-target contribution despite improved seen-target coverage.

Final lambda1-vs-lambda0 labels differ on 24.1694793%/11.7641454% of unique fit-seen nodes and .9885638%/.5084350% of unseen nodes. These descriptive facts motivate checking actual local scales, not a causal claim.
Global Markov degree bound gives no positive lower bound for fit targets: the global high-degree upper bound exceeds the at-most-200K unique targets.

allowed_numeric_reads: Frozen original graph adjacency only, in bounded row blocks
Existing extracted fit20K GT10 only, full hash and unique10-per-row validation
Previously verified common-init and lambda0/lambda1 final labels only, exact hashes
input_boundaries.allowed_provenance_reads: Fresh streaming SHA256 of full frozen native graph file, including uninterpreted embedded-vector bytes solely for input identity; reparse small header/length metadata and compare exactly to P0. No vector arithmetic or base-array loading. Info JSON hash rechecked. GT10 and label hashes freshly verified.

degree_contract.out: Count original directed valid nonself slots from u; retain duplicate directed arcs.
degree_contract.in: Count original directed valid nonself slots arriving at u, retaining duplicate arcs.
degree_contract.padding: Only -1 allowed; -1 ignored, self arcs ignored consistently with fixed J; other negative/out-of-range ID is integrity failure.
checks: Full native index SHA and metadata equals P0
M and Q equal frozen partition/algebra metadata
Sum in = sum out = M, sum D = 2M
Fit count, unique target count, total occurrences and max occurrence reproduce completed target diagnosis
Fixed-label movement group counts reproduce completed target diagnosis

condition.exact: D(u)*(9*Q) < M using int64 arithmetic; strict equality excluded.
condition.meaning: For this node, any feasible candidate move with integer DeltaS<=-1 strictly lowers J_lambda1 regardless of its cut change; only a sufficient condition.
condition.units: M counts original directed valid nonself slots, Q=20000 fit query rows.
condition.report: Report exact measured coverage for all nodes and fit support groups; no substitute from global average or sample estimate.

support.definition: f(u)=number of fit GT10 rows containing u, seen iff f>0; GT row has unique targets.
support.weighted_denominator: sum f(u) in the group; measures fit target occurrences, not unique nodes or independent queries; empty weighted denominator=null.

movement_groups.crossproduct: All 18 fixed cells retained including empty; changed and unchanged must exhaust each support population. End-state labels only, not accepted sequential moves.

summaries.quantile_method: Exact empirical inverted_cdf/order-statistic ceil(p*n)-1 clamped0; no interpolation, empty=null.

output: Complete per-dataset summary JSON with all groups, source/input hashes, M/Q and conservation checks, compact all-base total-degree histogram if <=1MiB; no million-row or raw-ID/GT/vector dumps. Top complete marker; interrupted output INCOMPLETE and preserved.
interpretation_limits: Measured support of a sufficient local condition does not show a GT-improving feasible candidate exists or is selected.
Does not reconstruct actual accepted-move DeltaC/DeltaS, temporal ordering or a unique contribution to final cut.
Unseen DeltaS=0 does not imply its trajectory is independent of GT-aware moves of other nodes, candidate sets or capacities.
Label changes, support, degrees and retrieval all correlate; no causal attribution or proof of memorization/connectivity failure.
No fixed-lambda change, second representation revision, new router, portal or auxiliary graph is authorized.

resources.launch: Root-controlled control/stage_run.py P3 split fit measurement analysis
